statement: For the zero-frequency four-cycle, the balancing equation k_10 k_32=k_12 k_30 produces a parametrized complex solution curve. In particular, when all couplings equal one, θ=(0,t+π,π,t), modulo 2π, is a real one-parameter family of equilibria. Thus phase fixing does not always make the fibre finite.

answer.text: For zero-frequency C4, balancing couplings yield complex solution curves; equal couplings give an explicit real one-parameter family.
